senses.definition: superlative form of low: most low
examples: Yang says he remembers being able to see the glacier’s lowest edge from his home village. But that time has passed.

quotes.text: At the lowest point, a short length of tunnel was driven alongside the up line, with a cross passage, to serve as a sump and pump house for dealing with any accumulation of water.
